<LawCallout code="ra10173" section="Section 11 - Security of Personal Information">
Legal Basis: RA 10173 (Data Privacy Act of 2012). Architects collecting/processing client personal data are 'personal information controllers' subject to NPC (National Privacy Commission) oversight.
</LawCallout>

[SLATECAMP_UI_BLOCK:ui_0003 component="Warn" status="preserved"]
Extracted summary:
- Props: (none)
- Text: Penalties: Unauthorized processing of personal info = 1-3 years imprisonment + fine up to PHP 2M. Unauthorized processing of SENSITIVE personal info = 3-6 years + fine up to PHP 5M. Architects must take data privacy obligations seriously.
[/SLATECAMP_UI_BLOCK]

- Text: Key principles: Consent (obtain explicit consent), Purpose Limitation (only collect what's needed for the project), Proportionality (reasonable necessity), Security (implement safeguards). Maintain a Data Privacy Manual and designate a DPO.
[/SLATECAMP_UI_BLOCK]
